svg.title: Golden star achievement badge
svg.desc: The gold frame grows from the center. A glossy golden star pops into place with a playful turn and bounce. Smaller golden accents and twinkling stars appear around it. Large dancing celebration rays, colorful confetti, and starbursts keep looping. Transparent vector artwork, with separate matching WAV sound.

g.aria-label: Gold rays, colorful confetti, and sparkling stars
